atomicity_precedence.node_rule: One task-essential typed V3.2 NODE remains one atomic capability with its independent typed selector/requirement correspondence.

v3_5_supplementation.controlling_sections: Accepted amendment Sections 4-10; existing meanings remain unchanged at their existing sites.
v3_5_supplementation.unit_rule: UNIT is a statement result/context marker, never an edge payload or replacement. Actual statements use their specified decision, committed-value or display-argument site.

B.site: Exact mapped Boolean result, control decision or Boolean operand-use destination.

N.site: Exact numeric result/read/write or directed-value destination; preserve indicator refinement.

F.role: Single signed-integer field or serialized scalar numeric text before decoding.

A.role: Exact raw four-field array input entering SPLIT, retaining frozen pipe grammar.

T4.role: Exact four-text-field result/destination with shape, position and order retained.

I4.role: Exact four-integer-field destination with shape, position and order retained.

S.site: Selected accumulator-contribution writer/edge application; retain prior accumulator state. Not initialization, prior read, index step or whole phase.

D.site: Exact final display argument; preserve statement execution, integer/newline schema and UNIT result.

C.role: Only an independently emitted fixed-separator relation whose schema-valid payload set is singleton pipe.

J.role: Only the existing certified local AND/proven-0-1-product pair-joint semantic-result key; independent AND and MUL abilities retain B and N and both-condition coverage.

v3_5_supplementation.existing_api_meanings: Numeric API result uses N; SPLIT result uses T4; INPUT/INPUT_DOMAIN uses domain all-zero then all-one input at its prospectively bound typed root, with complete macro connectivity/schema/class evidence.
v3_5_supplementation.restrictions: Only independently permitted current operations/formal roles consume these types. No new formal port, malformed decoder input, text/package accumulator, topology rewrite or expanded V3.3 equivalence.
v3_5_supplementation.class_selection: Prospective category, operation, payload/result type and destination/contribution role under amendment Section 4 precedence; never condition label, task ID, witness or outcome.
v3_5_supplementation.attribute_separation: VALUE_OR_LITERAL and OUTPUT_CATEGORY retain their distinct non-interventional evidence classes. Constant-bearing edges retain independent directed-edge interventions.
v3_5_supplementation.SCIENTIFIC_INTERVENTION_CLASS_MISSING: Scientific incompleteness and FAIL; not an implementation ticket.
v3_5_supplementation.MAPPING_NOT_YET_BUILT: Later faithful representation/implementation work; no changed scientific meaning and no candidate-generation permission.

normal_event_and_witness_rules.payload_zero_rule: A threshold or prior zero may participate in its own genuine nonzero update; global positivity or another independent contribution does not supply the event.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.initialization_rule: Requires its legitimate connected downstream event; empty traversal plus a displayed offset does not supply decoder/body activity.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.final_display_and_output_edge: Actual nonzero final displayed integer on that computation; zero-only display is not rescued by forced output.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.structured_payload_rule: Exact executed consumption on its own connected normal-event path.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.quantification: All mapped instances of the selected key together, including all dynamic executions of all mapped static sites; no convenient occurrence, phase or last-iteration selection.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.ordering: Lexicographically first qualifying frozen case and first successful intervention in the class's fixed order; inherited attribute/output witness order remains.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.required_intervention_failure: Unavailable, malformed, untypable or unexecutable required intervention remains UNRESOLVED/FAIL; earlier success, artificial loop clamp, bounded replay or timeout waiver cannot repair it.
normal_event_and_witness_rules.engine_requirement: Exact class semantics and source/IR bindings must later be reviewed, frozen and tested before candidate generation; no such execution is authorized by this artifact.

output_category_declaration.criterion: For contract C with complete frozen valid domain D_C and exact frozen target function F_C, declare K iff there exists x in D_C such that F_C(x) belongs to K.

output_category_declaration.proof_requirement: Bind exact target, roles, offset and domain; prove inclusion of every declared category and absence of every undeclared category.
output_category_declaration.evidence_rule: Attainability declares requirements only. COVERED requires an actual frozen expected-output case whose final correct displayed integer satisfies the category. Symbolic proof, source literal, initialization or intermediate state is not a witness.

paired_training_declaration.rule: Apply the SAME declaration algorithm independently to each member's already-frozen target function, using its own complete domain, roles and offset.
paired_training_declaration.protected_scaffold: Paired source, prompt, input, case IDs/order, declarations, APIs, branches, loop, display, schedule, budgets and E3 comparison remain unchanged outside the sole marked treatment.

output_v3_4_scope.rule: Each evaluation-essential OUTPUT_CATEGORY key requires at least one same-domain training example whose own contract declares it and whose actual frozen-case evidence covers it independently in ISOLATED and COMPOSITION.
output_v3_4_scope.own_declared_category_case_obligations: Every training program must witness its own declared categories among its existing five frozen cases; another example's witness does not repair that obligation.

symbolic_attainability_procedure.numeric: All current targets are nonnegative. Empty traversal attains the exact fixed offset; zero is attainable exactly for zero offset. Positive and multidigit attainability, including unbounded counts/products/PREFIX/TWO_PASS, follows from the symbolic divisible-n, first-half, odd/residue construction over the unbounded frozen numeric domain. Sampling pools are not domain bounds.
symbolic_attainability_procedure.array: At each original index 0..3, exact sign/parity/magnitude/value-versus-index interval cells cover the complete signed-integer domain. Their ordered four-position mask product with the exact frozen target law/recurrence and offset determines the complete image.
symbolic_attainability_procedure.array_prefix: At most six strict ordered pairs; zero-offset ARRAY PREFIX cannot attain multidigit output.
symbolic_attainability_procedure.role: Future complete-domain declaration-proof obligations, not case generation or V3.5 evidence.
